physical_run_ID.state: Use every native state species/variable and geometry quantity required to restart the exact model. Activity alone is insufficient. Inactive pools and Spring geometry/rest-state variables remain included.
physical_run_ID.container_hashes: When checkpoint NPZ container hashes differ, compute and compare actual fullstate/geometry arrays with an explicit model-native state schema; container inequality alone is not physical inequality. Preserve both original container hashes and the verified numeric identity.
physical_run_ID.independence: Never merge different effective stochastic seeds or forcing laws merely because active fields, scalar summaries or initial active profiles match.
physical_run_ID.controls: Deterministic mean/zero controls retain source dummy seeds as provenance, but effective stochastic seed is absent and stochastic independent-seed/bootstrap counts are zero.

latent_Gaussian_cohort_ID.purpose: Preserve paired Gaussian driving paths across E1 sigma arms.
latent_Gaussian_cohort_ID.includes: Declared paired latent-path family, model/geometry/condition context, native horizon and seed/path identity with actual Gaussian-knot hashes or exact native proof.
latent_Gaussian_cohort_ID.sigma: Sigma branches remain distinct physical runs but share their declared latent Gaussian cohort. Do not count those branches as extra independent latent seed blocks.
latent_Gaussian_cohort_ID.no_guessing: An equal integer seed or equal activity arrays alone cannot prove a shared latent cohort.

E4_prefix_and_topup_relation.purpose: Separate the physical long run from its original-prefix relation and new independent top-up status.
preserve: retained_prefix declaration and exact prefix audit
original physical run/cohort reference when verified
E4_prefix_and_topup_relation.horizon: A different horizon is a different physical-run ID. Shared-prefix/continuation dependence is represented explicitly, never hidden by merging run IDs.
E4_prefix_and_topup_relation.counts: Report physical runs, observed histories and unique latent seed/cohort lineages separately. A longer view of a retained trajectory is not an extra independent seed.

selection: Use the canonical physical-run ID for stable medoid ties and deterministic random hashes within each frozen context/condition. Retain source observation IDs and exact canonical mappings on every page.
timing: Freeze the exact canonical case-ID/fullstate/latent/prefix map and its input hashes before loading future selection features. No new native integration is needed.
missing_or_ambiguous_identity: Fail the preselection identity gate and report the unresolved declaration; do not infer independence from active-field similarity.
